news.headline: ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Review: Obefazimod Sustains Week-44 Remission With No Dose-Dependent Malignancy Signal
news.summary: A detailed clinical review of the Phase 3 ABTECT Part 2 maintenance package confirmed that 37.2% of induction non-responders reached clinical remission and 34.5% endoscopic remission at Week 44 on continued 50 mg obefazimod, and that dose escalation to 50 mg recaptured clinical remission in 45.5% of patients who had relapsed in Part 1. Crucially for the June malignancy overhang, the expanded exposure showed malignancy and non-melanoma skin cancer rates consistent with UC background rates and no apparent dose-dependent signal.

news.headline: TCG Crossover and Chen Yu Report 7.0% Stake in Abivax After the July Offering
news.summary: Healthcare crossover investor TCG Crossover (Funds I and II, via managing partner Chen Yu) disclosed beneficial ownership of 6,007,834 ADSs, or 7.0% of Abivax, based on 86.09 million shares outstanding after the July 2, 2026 offering. It confirms that a dedicated biotech specialist held on through the large equity raise rather than selling into strength.

news.headline: Invus Entities Disclose 6.0% Beneficial Stake in Abivax
news.summary: Long-standing shareholder Invus (together with the Avicenna Fund) reported 4,825,759 ordinary shares and ADSs, equal to 6.0% of Abivax as of June 30, 2026. Alongside the TCG filing it rounds out an August picture of a stable, concentrated institutional register ahead of the NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback and aligned with Abivax on the planned submission strategy, content and format of the obefazimod NDA in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. Abivax confirmed it remains on track to file its first-ever NDA by the end of 2026, removing a key procedural uncertainty. This is the company's most recent press release; the newsflow has been quiet since.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180 from $132, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its target well above the prevailing share price, citing growing confidence in the obefazimod UC data package and the NDA timeline after the maintenance results and pre-NDA FDA feedback. It sits at the top of a sell-side range whose consensus target stood at roughly $166 as of late August (Piper Sandler $175, Jefferies Buy at $158).

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax hired four senior commercial executives covering marketing, patient services, sales/commercial operations and market access/pricing, recruited from Amgen, Takeda, AbbVie, Eli Lilly and Abbott with launch track records on Entyvio, Humira and Tezspire. The build-out signals the company intends to launch obefazimod in the U.S. on its own rather than depend on a partner or acquirer.

news.headline: Valerio Therapeutics Signs Exclusive Worldwide R&D Collaboration With Abivax for Next-Generation Immune-Mediated Disease Candidates
news.summary: Valerio Therapeutics announced a binding term sheet with Abivax for an exclusive worldwide research and development collaboration, receiving roughly EUR 2.4 million upfront plus development and commercial milestones, royalties on net sales and sublicensing revenue, subject to a definitive agreement. The partners will identify, design and preclinically evaluate next-generation candidates for immune-mediated inflammatory diseases, giving Abivax an early pipeline option beyond obefazimod.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax has this date fixed in its published financial calendar. The report will show the first post-raise balance sheet (cash was EUR 491.6m at March 31, 2026 before the $920m July offering, with runway now guided into Q4 2029) and the step-up in R&D and pre-launch commercial spend. Expect a business update on NDA preparation and the U.S. commercial build-out alongside the numbers.

catalysts.label: Euronext Paris annual index review - possible CAC 40 / CAC Next 20 promotion
catalysts.detail: The Euronext index Scientific Council runs its annual review each September; the 2025 edition (decision September 11, effective September 19) moved Abivax into the CAC Mid 60 and SBF 120. With a market capitalisation now around EUR 8.5bn, Abivax is a plausible candidate for a step up into the larger Paris indices, which would force passive buying. Nothing has been announced and promotion is not assured.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance dataset at a major gastroenterology congress
catalysts.detail: Abivax presented its ABTECT induction late-breaker at UEG Week in October 2025 and has a consistent pattern of taking full datasets to autumn congresses. A detailed public presentation of the Week-44 maintenance efficacy and, above all, the complete malignancy/safety database would be the cleanest way to fully retire the June cancer-signal overhang. Neither a venue nor an abstract acceptance has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction data, the 44-week maintenance readout, the Part 2 refractory-patient dataset and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026. This is the single biggest near-term de-risking event and the gate that starts the FDA review clock. Management has reiterated the timeline at every update this year.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe in the second half of 2026, contingent on the (now positive) 44-week maintenance data. Recent communication has emphasised the Q4 2026 FDA filing without restating a precise EMA date, so exact MAA timing remains unconfirmed and could slip into H1 2027.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027 (enrollment started Q3 2024). A positive readout opens a second large indication for the miR-124 mechanism and is the main pipeline diversification event, but it likely lands near or just after the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision and U.S. launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, i.e. in H2 2027 - after the March-2027 call expiry. No PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted. The commercial organisation being hired now is being built against this window, making it the ultimate approval and revenue catalyst for the equity.

pulse: Abivax trades at $113.51 per ADS on August 31, 2026 (market cap about $10.6bn, 52-week range $69.81-$148.83), having drifted back roughly 7% from its mid-August level in a news vacuum - the company has issued no press release since the July 30 pre-NDA announcement. Fundamentally the story is de-risked and now about execution: ABTECT induction plus Week-44 maintenance data are strong (about 51% remission vs 10% placebo, 37.2% of induction non-responders converted and 45.5% of relapsers recaptured on 50 mg), the Part 2 safety database shows malignancy rates in line with UC background rates, FDA alignment on the NDA is locked in for a late-Q4 2026 filing, and the $920m raise funds a solo U.S. launch into Q4 2029 with a senior commercial team already hired. Sell-side consensus sits near $166 with Morgan Stanley at $180; for the March-2027 $120 call the position is now slightly out of the money and hinges on the September 21 H1 report, a likely autumn congress presentation of the full safety dataset, the NDA landing on time, and whether takeover speculation re-ignites before expiry.
